diagnosisRequirements.evidenceText: Patient must have HER2-overexpressing breast cancer (IHC 3+ or FISH-positive) documented by pathology.
Baseline cardiac function (LVEF) must be ≥50% documented within 3 months prior to treatment initiation.

otherRequirements.requirement: Prior authorization required before treatment initiation
otherRequirements.evidenceText: Authorization must be requested at least 5 business days before the first dose.

otherRequirements.requirement: Coverage authorized for up to 12 months with quarterly re-authorization
otherRequirements.evidenceText: Initial authorization period is up to 12 months. Continuation requires reauthorization every 3 months with evidence of ongoing clinical benefit.
